page_title: RBL 1-1 WER | RB Leipzig v Werder Bremen 11/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Sascha Stegemann is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.

90+4' What a great chance for Jens Stage (Werder Bremen). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header inside the right post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save.
90+3' Corner kick. Werder Bremen will have an opportunity.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) but poses no threat.
90' Werder Bremen work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
89' Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) tries his luck from the edge of the box, but it's one to forget and goes well wide of the left post.
88' Ole Werner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Dawid Kownacki (Werder Bremen) replacing Marvin Ducksch.
88' Christian Gross (Werder Bremen) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Leonardo Bittencourt.
88' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from RB Leipzig comes to nothing.
88' Surely that's handball by one of the Werder Bremen players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!

87' Eljif Elmas (RB Leipzig) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. The referee signals a corner kick to RB Leipzig.
80' We are about to witness a substitution. Christopher Lenz (RB Leipzig) is replacing Amadou Haidara.
78' A substitution has been made. Milos Veljkovic is replaced by Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen).
77' Marco Rose decides to make a substitution. Lukas Klostermann will be replaced by El Chadaille Bitshiabu (RB Leipzig).
73' The attendance is 47069.
68' Here comes a substitution. Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) is brought on as a substitute for Felix Agu.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nick Woltemade trots off the pitch and is replaced by Jens Stage (Werder Bremen).
64' Marco Rose has decided to make a change. Eljif Elmas (RB Leipzig) replaces Christoph Baumgartner.
64' Substitution. Nicolas Seiwald makes way for Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig).
64' The game is interrupted as Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) is flagged offside.
61' 1 - 1 Goal! Mohamed Simakan gets to the ball and heads it over the defence to Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig), who meets it nicely and fires in into the back of the net. 1:1.
59' Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails narrowly wide of the left post!
57' The linesman signals that Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
55' Flag up against Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
54' RB Leipzig take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
51' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.

49' Lukas Klostermann (RB Leipzig) latches on to the ball from the corner kick and sends in a snap shot from the edge of the box. He can't direct his shot goalwards as it goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
49' RB Leipzig have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
47' RB Leipzig quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

47' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) latches onto a precise lofted pass into the penalty area and produces a header at goal, but his attempt under the bar fails to beat Michael Zetterer, who makes a sensational save. The ball goes out of play. RB Leipzig are awarded a corner kick.
46' Substitution. Yussuf Poulsen will be replaced by Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig).
46' Referee Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) tries an acrobatic volley inside the box that disappears way over the bar.
45+4' Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Michael Zetterer.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
43' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) leans back and sends a volley soaring over the bar from inside the box.
42' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by RB Leipzig, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
41' Werder Bremen concede a free kick after one of their players holds onto an opposition player. It's a free kick to RB Leipzig in a dangerous position.
40' The RB Leipzig players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

36' 0 - 1 Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) attempts to head the ball away after a cross into the penalty area, but instead he accidentally sends it inside the left post of his own goal. The goalkeeper was helpless.
34' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
33' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
31' One of the RB Leipzig players was holding his opponent and the referee doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
29' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
28' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
27' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) inside the box.
26' Nick Woltemade (Werder Bremen) sends a cross into the box, but Peter Gulacsi comes off his line to gather the ball.
25' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Milos Veljkovic (Werder Bremen).
23' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) meets a cross inside the box, but Peter Gulacsi wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
22' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
20' One of the Werder Bremen players commits a holding foul and the referee reaches for his whistle.
17' The Werder Bremen players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
13' Milos Veljkovic (Werder Bremen) sends a long ball in, but Peter Gulacsi comfortably gathers the ball.
12' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from RB Leipzig.
8' Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) is penalised for a foul. Sascha Stegemann had a clear view and blows his whistle.
5' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Peter Gulacsi, who smothers the ball.
4' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Werder Bremen will kick-off.
Sascha Stegemann will officiate today.
